card.name: Pieces inside codes and number lists
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of identifiers, digit sequences or abbreviation lists, such as a repeated 'ps' in a repec code or a leading 0 in a list of two-digit numbers.

modes.label: Digit sequences
modes.description: A digit or space inside a comma-separated list of numbers.

modes.label: Identifier pieces
modes.description: Repeated letter pieces inside a catalogue-style code.

modes.label: Abbreviation lists
modes.description: Start of an abbreviation or name within a list of short codes and names.
modes.example: Me, Mertz Glacier;<< Ni>>, Ninnis Glacier; WSB

card.writes: It suppresses tokens that end a line, so the text is expected to carry on rather than break.
card.plain: It fires inside strings of codes or numbers where the text must continue on the same line.
